interface.name: enzui_assistant_input_v1

description.summary: scope virtual devices to an Assistant portal session

interface.description: Only the remote desktop portal can bind this interface. Bind once per Assistant session. Attach both devices before forwarding any EIS input. Destroy the object after closing the session and its devices, including when the compositor requests revocation.

request.name: verify_session

description.summary: check the Shell's pending Assistant session

request.description: Check the exact portal session path registered by the admitted Shell. Verification does not attach input devices or grant access.
